name: raw-code-p4
note: A raw-code response with no <file> tags and no fence. Pattern 4 (the raw-code rescue) must recover it WHEN A WORKSPACE IS GIVEN, and must extract NOTHING without one. This fixture exists because the earlier ones never exercised Pattern 4 — they called the extractor with workspaceRoot undefined, so a regression in the raw-code rescue would have passed every test.
